answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. What survives to the vault is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the nebula of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ocean re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
